The idea

Pick up where
you left off.

The decisions, discoveries, and context around a codebase belong with the work. Knitt brings persistent context to coding agents through shared repository memory.

Shared memory

Repository context that coding agents can share across sessions.

Connected through MCP

A common interface for agents to work with repository memory.

Capture hooks

Carry useful context forward as part of your coding workflow.
